data.action: 单手持剑，剑锋斜指地面
data.description: 【史尔特尔 · 演武场】训练场中央焦黑的地面上还残留着灼烧的青烟，史尔特尔单手斜提魔剑，剑尖在合金地板上划出一道耀眼的火星。她甩开额前的汗湿碎发，向你投来好战的目光——「刚才那场演练的热身勉强合格。博士，下一个对手是谁？可别让我等太久。」
data.promptProse: At the Rhodes Island training ground, Surtr holds her sword in one hand with its tip angled toward the scorched floor, smirking competitively at the viewer. Black-and-gold rock tailcoat, gold epaulets, chains, lace shirt and leather trousers retain the chosen outfit. The low dynamic view follows burn marks behind her. Cool morning light catches sword and chain edges, while small blade sparks briefly warm the nearer floor's charred texture.
data.title: 史尔特尔 · 演武场
